result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the top-right account/notification control appears to be missing its main icon or avatar content.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right header is an empty light-gray circle with only a red notification dot, making its purpose unclear and making it appear as though the profile/avatar or notification icon failed to render.
issues.suggestion: Display the intended profile avatar or a clear notification/account icon inside the circle, while retaining the red badge if applicable.
